name: Village of Dobbs Ferry
gaps: County codes OF1-OF6, MDR1, MDRH, MF1-MF4 = code's OF-1 to OF-6, MDR-1, MDR-H, MF-1 to MF-4

Many dimensions are 'greater of' or 'lesser of' sliding scales tied to lot width/depth or neighborhood context (Tables B-3 to B-5, § 300-35D); the district minimums from Tables B-1/B-2 are recorded and the scales described in notes

Table B-3 coverage multipliers (0.82 / 0.75 / 0.67 / 0.56 by lot size): unclear from § 300-35D(9) whether they apply on top of the district percentage in every case, so the unadjusted Table B-1/B-2 percentage is recorded
max_height_ft is the steep-roof (pitch > 0.30) maximum from Table B-6; lower roofs get 30-37 ft and one-family districts also face context-based ridge/eave limits
MDR-H has no entry in Table B-6 height table
No floor-area (FAR/GFA) cap for one-family homes found
No fixed local wetland/watercourse buffer: Planning Board may impose buffers for wetlands over 4,000 sf (§ 300-46G)
B (Broadway) front yard is the prevailing setback (no fixed minimum), so front_ft is null

wetlands.summary: § 300-46G: in site plan review the Planning Board applies state/federal wetland rules and may require mitigation and impose buffers for wetlands over 4,000 sf; no fixed local buffer width.

steep_slopes.summary: § 300-46C: no development on areas of 1,500+ sf at 35%+ slope (limited exceptions); building on 25%+ slopes to be avoided. Net lot area deducts 50% of 25%+ slopes and 25% of 15-25% slopes (§ 300-34A(2)).

trees.summary: § 300-51: permit to remove protected trees: 6 in.+ DBH anywhere, 3 in.+ DBH in wetland/watercourse buffers or on 25%+ slopes, and trees required by approvals; replanting required.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 262: SWPPP for land development of 1+ acre of disturbance (or part of a larger common plan).

adu.summary: § 300-39: ADU by Planning Board special permit in a one-family house or permitted accessory building (accessory building only in MDR districts); owner-occupied, 300 sf to the lesser of 800 sf or 33% of the house, max 2 bedrooms.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings: district front setback from any street, 5 ft from side and rear lot lines, not in front of the house, max 20 ft and 1.5 stories, included in coverage; max 800 sf total in MDR districts (§ 300-54A).
general.pools: No zoning setback beyond building-code fencing; a pool cabana follows accessory shed/garage setbacks (§ 300-54N).
general.notes: Maximum front yard in OF-4 to OF-6 is the prevailing setback. Historic district and view-protection review (§ 300-46D) may apply.

max_building_coverage.note: Lot coverage by buildings (incl. accessory buildings). Table B-3 multiplies building and impervious coverage by 0.82 / 0.75 / 0.67 / 0.56 for lots of 7,500-10,000 / 10,000-20,000 / 20,000-40,000 / 40,000+ sf

max_impervious_coverage.note: Lot coverage by impervious surfaces. Table B-3 multiplies building and impervious coverage by 0.82 / 0.75 / 0.67 / 0.56 for lots of 7,500-10,000 / 10,000-20,000 / 20,000-40,000 / 40,000+ sf

OF6.source: § 300-35D; Appendix B Table B-1, Table B-6 (height), Table B-7
OF6.notes: Max front yard = prevailing setback. Table B-6: 30 ft (roof pitch up to 0.25), 33 ft (0.25-0.30), 35 ft (over 0.30); eave max 28 ft; also capped at 1.25x average ridge (eave 1.15x) of context-area houses, never required below 2.5 stories/28 ft; 45-degree sky exposure plane from 10 ft above lot lines (Table B-7). Sliding scales (§ 300-35D): side yards are the greater of the district minimum or Table B-4 by lot width (e.g. 12/30 ft at 100-125 ft, 15/35 ft at 125-150 ft, 20/50 ft at 150+ ft); rear yard the greater of district or Table B-5 (40 ft for lots 125+ ft deep); front yard the lesser of prevailing setback +/-10% or the district/Table B-5 minimum; min lot area is the greater of the district minimum or the average lot within 400 ft. Lot area is net of 50% of 25%+ slopes and 25% of 15-25% slopes (§ 300-34A(2)).
